answer.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both down 4-6% QoQ. Memory_31 and memory_86 provide the strongest precedent for addressing both metrics simultaneously through onboarding simplification—both showed durable improvements in completion and early activation. We're verifying these because they're foundational to the chosen action and we need confidence in the effect sizes before committing. Memory_91 supports the complementary insight that activation messaging alone can nudge engagement. Simplify_onboarding is more defensible than promo_pricing (which memory_73 shows is not repeatable and would erode margin under competitive pressure) and more immediately addressable than referral_incentive (which works on established customers, not the current activation crisis). Enterprise_sales_assist targets a different segment and doesn't address the SMB activation decline. A standard_experiment tests the intervention on the segment most affected by current headwinds before broader rollout.
